summary: Iteration 16 — Mechanical resolve push + Live mini-map. Backend: 7/7 pytest passing (4 existing resolve regression + 3 new in-process push assertions patching server.push_to_all_except via httpx ASGI). Confirmed correct signature: on resolve title='🔧 Mechanical resolved', body '<reporter>: ✅ Fixed — on their way' or '🚴 Carrying on without them', data.type='chat.mechanical.resolved' with status+original_id. Create endpoint push regression also verified with title '🔧 Mechanical', data.type='chat.mechanical' and data.maps_link included when lat/lng supplied. Frontend: mini-map renders at chat top with OSM tile layer + red divIcon pin, count pill reads 'N open mechanical(s)', clicking pin opens popup with Open-in-Google-Maps link (testid mechanical-mini-map-open-<id>) pointing at the correct maps_link URL. After resolving all open mechanicals via API the mini-map disappears (count = 0). Chat still auto-scrolls; follow-up bubble 'Fixed — on my way' appears from reporter. Mobile RN fallback banner code path verified in /app/mobile/src/tabs/ChatTab.js (testID='mechanical-live-banner', pill testIDs 'mechanical-live-open-<id>' calling Linking.openURL(m.mechanical.maps_link)).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); consider migrating to FastAPI lifespan handlers (non-blocking).

MechanicalMiniMap slices to last 6 active mechanicals but count pill shows active.length (also capped at 6) — if more than 6 exist the pill under-reports. Consider showing total unresolved count separately.
